description: Execute shell commands to process data or invoke system tools

data_input.info: Upstream data (Shell scripts typically used for file operations and system commands, less common for data streams)

script.info:
Write shell commands to execute system operations

[Use Cases]
• File operations (copy, move, compress, etc.)
• System command execution (ls, grep, awk, etc.)
• External tool invocation (curl, wget, etc.)
• Environment variable operations

[Output Methods]
After execution, the following information is captured:
• stdout - Standard output
• stderr - Error output
• exit_code - Command exit code (0 = success)

[Debug Output]
Use echo for debug messages. After execution, view complete logs in node status including:
• Start time and duration
• Standard output and error output
• Exit code and execution status

[Example Commands]
# List current directory
ls -la

# Process text files
cat input.txt | grep 'pattern' | wc -l

# Use environment variables
echo "Working directory: $PWD"
script.default_code:
#!/bin/bash

# Example: List current directory
echo "List files in current directory:"
ls -la

# Output system info
echo ""
echo "System information:"
uname -a

echo ""
echo "Shell script executed successfully"

working_directory.info: Working directory for script execution (defaults to current directory)

timeout.info: Script execution timeout, will terminate if exceeded (default 300 seconds)

capture_output.info: Capture standard output and error output, shown in node status log
